brief:
Palestinian settlement affairs expert Khalil al-Tafakji told Shehab Wire that Israel is rapidly intensifying demolition orders against Palestinian homes and infrastructure across the West Bank. He said the surge reflects an Israeli right-wing strategy to establish maximum facts on the ground ahead of upcoming elections, creating conditions that would be difficult for any future government to reverse or dismantle.

The accelerated pace of demolitions underscores Palestinian concerns that settlement expansion is being systematized around Israel's electoral calendar. Officials in Ramallah have long warned that such moves during political transition periods lock in territorial control through irreversible changes to the physical landscape, narrowing options for successor administrations regardless of their stated positions on settlements.

title: Israel accelerates settlement facts on ground before elections, expert says
